data.text: Benchmark 2026-09-28, 100 questions (25 golden + 75 paraphrases written blind by a separate agent over a seeded random sample of records). search --json: right record in top 3 for 51, top 5 for 54, empty on 10 answerable questions; ~580 tokens per call, ~2k with the top hit opened. Grep over .kadence/events, reading the 3 best-matching files: 22 found (naive: two longest words) to 36 (generous: every query word, best-ranked); 10.7k-13.4k tokens per attempt. So 5-20x fewer tokens and more right answers, but half the paraphrases still miss. The awkward part: nothing calls search by default - the SessionStart hook runs prime only, and in this session the agent reached for decision list and grep first despite CLAUDE.md listing search. Scripts and per-question rows were in the session scratchpad, not committed.
